fact: Fundacion IDENTIC says it signed incubation agreements with six Campus Connect winning projects in the week of 5 March 2026, giving them mentoring, training and business-model validation.
Africanian reports Dreams Hub, an AfriLabs member in Malabo, has La Capsula, a space dedicated to incubating entrepreneurial initiatives, with no cohort programme described.

The UN in Equatorial Guinea says the Guinea ON incubator, run in 2022 by UNDP and the telecommunications ministry, trained about 60 young people in Malabo and Bata and led to 10 startups each funded with 6 million FCFA.
Africanian reports Dreams Hub in Malabo opened its incubation and accelerator office LA CAPSULA, with the three TotalEnergies Startupper Challenge winners as the first cohort.
